title: Opens principal in two affine opens form a basis of their intersection
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U,V\subseteq X$ affine opens and $x\in U\cap V$. For $f\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ write $D_U(f)=\{y\in U:f(y)\neq0\text{ in }\kappa(y)\}$ [def-weil-residue-field], and similarly $D_V(g)$ for $g\in\mathcal O_X(V)$. Then there are $f\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ and $g\in\mathcal O_X(V)$ with $D_U(f)=D_V(g)$ and $x\in D_U(f)$.
